{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify rows with missing revenue
missing_revenue = sales[sales['revenue'].isna()]

# Check the proportion of missing data
total_rows = len(sales)
missing_rows = len(missing_revenue)
proportion_missing = missing_rows / total_rows

# Print the proportion and the channel distribution of missing data
print(f'Proportion of rows with missing revenue: {proportion_missing:.2%}')
print('Channel distribution of missing revenue:')
print(missing_revenue['channel'].value_counts())"}
